citations.assessment: The passage is about the cauldron of the sons of Mar Ukva, with details about weighing and compensation. It is independent of the gentile’s cauldron in Avodah Zarah.
Tosafot expressly has Mar Ukva purchasing the cauldron and fitting a rim.
The commentary discusses chronology and the Akiva/Ukva reading with Rava. Its alternative explanations remain distinct from Heilprin’s inference.
